items.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 17 at 4:13AM PDT until October 17 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures in the upper 80s to the mid 90s expected.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas and San Diego County Coastal
Areas.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase during hot temperatures.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Low temperatures will be in the high 60s to
low 70s.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Take extra precautions when outside. Wear lightweight and loose
fitting clothing. Try to limit strenuous activities to early morning
or evening. Take action when you see symptoms of heat exhaustion and
heat stroke.

items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued October 17 at 7:31AM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
Elevated showers are tracking across the coastal waters this
morning, with isolated thunderstorms possible for areas south of
Solana Beach. Any thunderstorm can produce lightning and gusty,
erratic winds to 35 knots.

Mariners should move to safe harbor immediately until the storms
pass. Improved conditions are expected by 10 AM.
